brief:
Syria's Foreign Ministry condemned an Israeli drone strike targeting a civilian vehicle traveling on a road connecting Mezze Beit Jin and Beit Jin village in western rural Damascus, the Shehab Wire reported. The strike killed or wounded several civilians in the area.

The incident occurred along a route in the western outskirts of the capital. Syria has repeatedly protested Israeli military operations within its territory, characterizing such strikes as violations of Syrian sovereignty and international law. The attack comes amid persistent reports of Israeli airstrikes across Syrian airspace targeting various sites.
